description: Hydropower Infrastructure – LAkes, Reservoirs, and RIvers (HILARRI), Version 4 is a data set deposited in DOE Oak Ridge National Laboratory (ORNL) Repository by its authors Carly Hansen, Paul G. Matson (Oak Ridge National Laboratory (ORNL), Oak Ridge, TN (United States)). HILARRI is a database of links between major datasets of operational hydropower dams and powerplants, and inland water bodies. These connections are used when conducting large-scale analysis of hydropower infrastructure and their associated natural and engineered water systems.
